item.title: Vance: Nuclear talks showed some progress, but Iran won’t acknowledge Trump’s red lines

item.title: Smotrich says next government should ‘encourage migration’ of Palestinians from West Bank

item.title: What to know about key waterway that Iran declared closed as it holds military drill
item.description: Temporary closure of parts of the Strait of Hormuz, through which 20% of the world's oil passes, comes as US and Islamic Republic hold nuclear talks and their leaders exchange threats The post What to know about key waterway that Iran declared closed as it holds military drill appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Madrid museum ejects 3 elderly Israeli tourists who displayed Israeli flag, Star of David
item.description: Video shows the women being called 'genocidal maniacs' and 'murderers' at Reina Sofía Museum, which Jewish groups condemn for 'removing the victims' rather than those shouting at them The post Madrid museum ejects 3 elderly Israeli tourists who displayed Israeli flag, Star of David appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: American Jewish speedskater Emery Lehman wins silver medal at Winter Olympics

item.title: Reunifying Arab parties aim for more power, but may wind up with more Netanyahu
item.description: As Arab parties mull uniting in Joint List again, there are opposition worries that the juggernaut will end up weakening the anti-Netanyahu bloc, unintentionally keeping PM in power The post Reunifying Arab parties aim for more power, but may wind up with more Netanyahu appeared first on The Times of Israel.
